mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced consumer spending, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant rise in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening economy, leading to negative investor sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.
